items.headline: $ZEC Rockets to $1,383 While Market Dumps
items.summary: $ZEC defied a broad crypto selloff after the Fed's first rate hike since 2023, ripping to $1,383 as privacy coins caught a sudden bid.

items.headline: $ARC Mainnet Live: BlackRock, Visa Validate
items.summary: Circle launched its Arc L1 with $ARC (10B minted), USDC gas, and 100+ apps including Aave and Uniswap, validated by BlackRock, DTCC and Visa.

items.headline: $PONS Whale Nets $2M in 24 Hours
items.summary: Trader 'Bonk Guy' made ~$2.08M in a day topping the Fomo leaderboard, with $PONS as his largest holding — a signal the small-cap is heating up.

items.headline: $WLD Launches 'World Money' Super App
items.summary: World rolled out a self-custody $WLD super app with stablecoins, Stripe integration, Morpho lending and boosted rewards for World ID users.

items.headline: $HYPE RWA Trading Surges on Hyperliquid
items.summary: RWA trading is surging on Hyperliquid as tokenized stocks and bonds gain traction, and Kraken's parent now plans permissioned $HYPE perps for US traders.
